Definition: Zimmah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Zimmah = "plotter"; 1) a Gershonite Levite, son of Jahath; 2) another Gershonite, son of Shimei; perhaps the same as 1 above; 3) father or ancestor of Joah, a Gershonite in the reign of Hezekiah
